source: ## Runs 6–7 — spot-check audit before the fan

Raw traces precede onset and FFT analysis. These are the session-only inputs to the landau-fan-vti design; a harmonic-rich spectrum and a censored electron onset prevent a stacking call from these spots alone.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
for rid,n in [(6,3.2),(7,-1.2)]:
 r=open_run(Path('data')/str(rid)); ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
 plot_raw(r); plt.show()
 B=r.col('magnet_field'); I=r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain
 R=r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain/I
 print(f'Run {rid}, n={n}e12 cm^-2, D_A=0: complete={r.complete}, interrupted={r.interrupted}; R={R.min():.2f}..{R.max():.2f} ohm; drain={I.min()*1e9:.3f}..{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA')
 print('Gate current maxima (pA):',*[np.max(np.abs(r.col(c)))*1e12 for c in ['k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']])
 print('Temperature K:',np.min(r.col('T_sample')),np.max(r.col('T_sample')))
 # Electron <1 T has 50 mT sampling, unsuitable for the high-frequency onset audit.
 on=sdh_onset(R,B,b_lo=1.0 if rid==6 else .3,r_full_scale=50e-6/np.median(I))
 print(on.summary())
 fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4))
 for degree in (3,5,7):
  f,p=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(1.0,10),bg_degree=degree,nfft=4096,log=False)
  ax.plot(f,p[0]/p[0].max(),label=f'B=1..10 T, degree {degree}')
 ax.axvline(abs(n)*10.33916924,color='k',ls='--',label='geometry-prior F_L')
 ax.set(xlim=(0,60),xlabel='Frequency (T)',ylabel='Normalized FFT magnitude',title=f'Run {rid}: provisional spectrum, one polarity only')
 ax.legend(); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print('Interpretation: electron features near 7.3, 14.8, 22.3 and 29.4 T form a possible harmonic comb; frequency-versus-density is required. No stacking classification yet. The electron onset is censored at the adequately sampled 1 T edge; a low-field extension is needed before pricing a full fan. The hole spectrum is stronger but the available D=0 density range ends near -1.27e12, in the model near-degeneracy regime. Region-A calibration is operational; the second CNP ridge means spatial homogeneity cannot be assumed. Single-polarity FFTs retain possible Hall admixture.')

## HERA — resolve the censored onset before committing the fan

> **05:20** · Fan onset preflight: n=+3.2e12 D\_A=0, B 0.3 to 1.5 T, 268 inverse-B points, 50 uV, base T · **ETA ~05:50** (≈30 min)

`sdh-spot-check` and `landau-fan-vti` step 1 require a measured onset for the cheapest adequate fan. Run 6 / ana cell 15 returns a censored 7.3 T tone at the adequately sampled 1 T edge; its 50 mT points below 1 T cannot pin onset for F_L=33.09 T. Extend the same n=+3.2e12 cm^-2, D_A=0 point over 0.3–1.5 T, 268 inverse-B points (Δ1/B=0.00999 T^-1, 3.02 samples/F_L period), retaining 50 µV sensitivity and the driver's 3 s settle (10τ). The overlap checks acquisition reproducibility; this is the binding preflight for the requested electron fan, not a stacking claim.

The read-only preconditions compare all committed caps to the device card and check the handoff field, live thermometry, heaters, bias, contact map and acquisition settings. Field motion from 0 to 1.5 T costs 1.5/0.137=10.95 min; runs 6/7 measured about 3.1 s non-ramp overhead per point, giving 14 min more, plus reads/guard margin. Check first 20 points then completion for leakage, clipping and reproducibility. Leave field at 1.5 T and gates at the electron spot for the fan; no Si movement or pacing change. On interruption, read actual field again: the VTI magnet can continue to its last commanded target.

# Read-only preconditions; stop before any write on mismatch.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
for _p,_limits in [(k_tg.volt,(-.3,1.)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.)),(dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),(magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),(heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
 _actual=(_p.vals._min_value,_p.vals._max_value)
 print(_p.full_name,'validator expected',_limits,'actual',_actual)
 assert _actual==_limits
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10 and T_SESSION_CAP==100
for _name,_fn in [('T_sample',T_sample),('T_vaporizer',T_vaporizer)]:
 assert_thermometry_live(_name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[_name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_T0,_Tv,_B0,_Si=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field(),k_si()
print('Expected: base 1.0..1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K, field near 0 T, Si 0 V. Actual:',_T0,_Tv,_B0,_Si)
assert 1.0<=_T0<=1.5 and .5<_Tv<1.6 and abs(_Tv-_T0)<.6
assert abs(_B0)<.05 and abs(_Si)<.01
print('Expected heaters off, PS/output on:',heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range(),magnet.persistent_switch_on(),magnet.output_enabled())
assert heater.sample_range()==0 and heater.vaporizer_range()==0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
print('Expected DC205 RNGE 2/output 1:',dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output())
assert dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1
print('Expected drive 1 V/13.777 Hz, tau .3 s/slope24:',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency(),sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant(),sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<.01
assert sr0.time_constant()==.3 and sr1.time_constant()==.3 and sr0.filter_slope()==24 and sr1.filter_slope()==24
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
CAL=dict(c_tg=.002796,c_bg=.002161,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
# Nyquist on F_L=33.09 T with ~3 samples/cycle throughout.
B_vec=1/np.linspace(1/.3,1/1.5,268)
vt,vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0,**CAL)
for v in [vt]: k_tg.volt.validate(float(v))
for v in [vb]: k_bg.volt.validate(float(v))
for b in B_vec: magnet.field.validate(float(b))
assert magnet.settle_s>=3
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
mc=dict(meas_config); mc.update({'Si (V)':_Si,'sample_temperature:':_T0,'comments':'sdh-spot-check onset extension n=3.2e12 D_A=0; B=.3..1.5 T uniform inverse B 268 pts; 3 s magnet settle; run6 overlap'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(mc['comments'])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(vb)); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(vt)); interruptible_sleep(10)
# [time,B,T_sample,T_vaporizer,I_tg,I_bg,sr0X,sr0P,sr1X,sr1P]
for p in [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P]:
 s.fp(p); s.plot('time',p)
def onset_guard(station,data):
 if max(abs(float(data[4])),abs(float(data[5])))>1e-9 or abs(float(data[8]))>45e-6 or not 1.0<float(data[2])<1.5:
  print('ONSET QUALITY STOP',data); station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('ONSET END actual field/gates:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).

# === SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), B 0 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.05), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm = 1.4 % FS; MR + SdH maxima at high B size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 10 T (the hole-side spot check rides it down) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
